attributes.name: heightmap_mode
attributes.digest: Heightmap Mode
attributes.description: Heightmap mode to use when the heightmap input is in use (default = parallax).

choices.label: Parallax heightmap mode is used in conjunction with normal mapping to enhance the depth effect by displacing texture coordinates. A normals input is required when using parallax mode.

Vertex texture fetch mode samples the heightmap texture's first channel (red plane) in the vertex program and displaces the vertex position along its normal by that amount. vtf mode requires texture inputs must be non-rectangular (@rectangle 0).

choices.digest: Vertex texture fetch with normals generation mode
choices.label: Vertex texture fetch with normals generation mode is similar to vtf mode but it also regenerates lighting normals for the displaced mesh.
